note: The genre keys under the ring in the machine view (PLAN-GENRES; notes/analysis/genres-2026-09-25.md). A key is a spell and nothing else: `spell` names the birds away from the house, `reachable` false means the birds cannot reach the genre and the spell is the nearest the search found, `about` is the key's tooltip. Measured, never typed by hand: re-run tools/genres.ts and tools/genres.py before changing a spell. Since M7 (schema 2): two tiers. `families` are the grid's first tier, each with its own measured `spell`, `reachable` and `about`, and up to eight `subs`, its second tier; a sub with `tuned: true` carries a measured spell of its own, and one with `tuned: false` has none yet and plays its family's. The tuning of the subs is for a genres session. Since M10 a family carries `tuned` too: whether its own spell is one to play — measured and reached by the ring's controls (false where `reachable` is false, and for Dub, which borrows Dub Techno's). A key whose spell is not tuned is drawn disabled and does nothing; a family on the first tier still opens its tier. Since M18 a family or a sub-genre may carry `recipes`: the ids of the recipe library's rows (`packages/deep-house/recipes/genres/`) that belong to it, the library's own ids and never renamed, so the grid can later show which styles have recipes.

families.label: House
families.about: House: brighter (Zephyr 0.65), lighter underneath (Root 0.55), a little more motion (Spark 0.40). Measured 1.7–2.5 from the catalogue's house windows (0.8 from their own middle); the house spell reads 1.9, so this is a colour and not yet the genre. Missing: 113–122 BPM falls between the ring's controls' two bands, and the sets carry twice our onsets and mid-range hits (stabs, a busier kit): families and a tempo band.

subs.label: Deep House
subs.about: Deep House: the house spell, every control at home. The record the other eight are measured against.

subs.label: Tech House
subs.about: Tech house: the pulse into the fast band (Ember 0.70, 125–130 BPM by seed), four to the floor, brighter, lighter mass, drier. Measured 1.6–2.4 from the catalogue's tech house windows (1.0 from their own middle). Missing: the percussion density and the short held stabs the sets have (event rate and sustain 3 spreads under) — a percussion family and a stab part.

families.about: Techno: the pulse into the fast band (Ember 0.75, 125–130 BPM by seed), mass eased (Root 0.60), brighter, more change (Veil 0.60). Missing: held mid-range (sustain 2.6 spreads under) and a touch of syncopation; 136–140 BPM is out of the band.

families.label: Ambient & Downtempo
families.about: Ambient & Downtempo: the slow and the beatless, one family since M18 (his word: Ambient and Downtempo join). Its two measured spells are its Ambient and Downtempo keys; the family's own key has no spell of its own.

subs.label: Ambient
subs.about: Ambient: no drums (Ember 0.10), slow and wet (Tide 0.85), bright (Zephyr 0.90), long form (Loom 0.80). The ring's controls reach the form — no kick, 48–55 BPM, long tails — but nothing sounds above 4 kHz: the pads are the whole record and a texture or shimmer voice would be the top. The catalogue has no beatless window to hold it to; its 'ambient' is its slowest band, with a kick.

subs.label: Downtempo
subs.about: Downtempo, as near as the ring's controls get: a lighter pulse (Ember 0.30), wetter (Tide 0.70), less mass (Root 0.55). Measured 1.2–1.8 from the catalogue's downtempo windows on five seeds, where they sit 0.8 from their own middle and the house spell 1.6: the ring's controls cannot slow the kick under 95 BPM (the seed picks 95–105), and the sets are busier and more syncopated than any spell makes the record — a rhythm family's work, not a control's.

subs.label: Dub Techno
subs.about: Dub techno: the fast band four to the floor (Ember 0.72, Spark 0.10), very wet (Tide 0.90), dark (Zephyr 0.25), heavy (Root 0.85), slow change and long form. Measured 1.6–2.0 against a rule target (no dub in the catalogue: 118–126 BPM, long tails, darker than techno), 3.9 on one seed; the house spell reads 3.2. Missing: the tails are still short (decay 3.5 spreads under) — the dub chord through a long delay is a part and a treatment, not a control.

No spell is measured for it, so it has none, and its keys stay disabled until a genres session tunes it.
